a1.cap: Each node holds a map from letter to child node and a flag marking the end of a word. Inserting walks (and creates) one node per letter; searching walks the same path and checks the flag at the end.
Autocomplete, spell checkers and tokenizer vocabularies use tries.
Let's walk through it with the calls Trie(), insert("apple"), search("apple"), search("app"), startsWith("app"), insert("app"), search("app").
